newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise in quiet trade.

text.p: Prices firmed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Thursday in lira and dollar terms, while volume eased in quiet trade, dealers said.
Gold closed $2 up from Monday's close at $382.30 an ounce. There has been no dollar-based gold trading on the bourse since Monday as investors can make more profits on lira-based trade.
In lira terms, gold rose to 1,148,150 lira per gram from its 1,146,20 Wednesday close due to higher prices on the international market and a weaker lira.
The lira fell to 93,325 to the dollar from a 93,175 Wednesday close.
Traded volume fell to 320 kilos from Wednesday's 691 as demand in the free market slowed down.
"Lack of cash dollar demand and gold demand in the free market had a negative impact on gold trading on the bourse," said one dealer.
Prices stayed in a narrow trade in Europe and fixed at $381.60 an ounce, compared to $381.35 on Wednesday.
